_meta.purpose: Seed for the nightly Smart Judge eval (#987 T248): the owner's questions from the phone test call of 2026-11-21, where most answers were non-answers. Text only: no caller number, no audio, no room name.
_meta.type: integration eval: calls the live chat endpoint and therefore LLMs; NOT run in unit CI. Only the file shape is checked in CI (src/test_phone_owner_eval_seed.py).
_meta.run: python3 scripts/eval_chat_golden.py --set data/eval/chat_golden/phone_owner_2026-11-21.json --voice --base-url https://<host> (voice mode, as the phone line asks); without --voice = text mode. --validate checks the file offline.
_meta.status: DRAFT. Every key point is verify=TO-VERIFY: written at law-name level, NOT checked by a lawyer; do not treat as ground truth until it is.
_meta.matching: Same as golden_set.json. must_mention: each item is a list of alternative substrings (any one matches, after digit/ZWNJ normalisation). must_not_mention: regexes that must NOT appear; here they catch the non-answers of the real call (clarifying question instead of an answer, 'not in my sources').
_meta.fields: question = what the caller meant (wording: 'stt_fixed' = the transcript with the misheard terms corrected, 'inferred' = part of the transcript was unintelligible, see notes). stt_heard = what Whisper produced on the call (for STT repair regression, #989). channel = the channel the question came from.
